summary: Gates are clean and coverage is numerically generous, but none of the 112 items map a distractor to the chapter's own misconceptions (m1–m6), so add six MCQs that each test one documented misconception with a mapped wrong option.

improvements.why: misconception m2 (oxide effervesces in water) has no MCQ distractor testing it; ER 9701 w23 P21 Q2 reports this as a common error
improvements.what: MCQ: what is observed when solid barium oxide is added to water, with a distractor option describing bubbling/effervescence mapped to m2

improvements.why: misconception m3 (carbonate + acid gives carbonic acid only, no CO2/water split) has no MCQ distractor; ER 9701 w22 P21 Q2 notes candidates write H2CO3 instead of CO2 + H2O
improvements.what: MCQ: identify the correct set of products when a Group 2 carbonate reacts with excess dilute HCl, with a distractor giving only a salt and 'carbonic acid' mapped to m3

improvements.why: misconception m4 (nitrate decomposition gives NO rather than NO2) has no MCQ distractor; ER 9701 w21 P21 Q2 reports many candidates misbalance this equation
improvements.what: MCQ: pick the correctly balanced equation for thermal decomposition of a Group 2 nitrate, with a distractor equation producing NO instead of NO2 mapped to m4

improvements.why: misconception m5 (thermal stability decreases down the group) has no MCQ distractor, and KC 9701-10.1.4 has no genuine past-paper item among the 12 curated 'p' items despite several being tagged to it in the bundle (e.g. w25_13_q19, w23_13_q19)
improvements.what: MCQ comparing decomposition temperatures of two named Group 2 carbonates or nitrates, with a distractor reversing the trend mapped to m5

improvements.why: misconception m6 (hydroxides and sulfates follow the same solubility trend) has no MCQ distractor despite being the most-tested idea in this chapter (44 items touch 9701-10.1.5)
improvements.what: MCQ asking which Group 2 statement is correct across hydroxide and sulfate solubility, with a distractor claiming both increase (or both decrease) down the group mapped to m6

improvements.why: misconception m1 (magnesium reacts vigorously with cold water) has no MCQ distractor, and 9701-10.1.1 has only one genuine past-paper item among the curated 'p' items
improvements.what: MCQ on the observation when magnesium ribbon is placed in cold water, with a distractor describing vigorous bubbling/fast reaction mapped to m1
